scope: Executed digital checks on the documented Windows toolchain; no biological or fabricated-hardware validation

studies.missing_sensor_measurements: NaN only for flagged unavailable or invalid/stale observations; preserved in CSV, represented as null in presentation data

digital_protocol.limit: Host timing and ideal protocol only; no MCU, ADC or fitted stimulation-to-physiology mapping

electronics.limit: Generic device/RC models and selected cases; clean rule checks do not establish analog, fabrication or implant safety

CAD.limit: Nominal geometry only; no fabrication fit, materials, thermal or anatomical validation

presentation.video_review: Eight caption plates visually inspected; browser loaded 72-second video without a media error
browser_checks: Three trace selectors changed displayed legend and caption
No horizontal overflow in the default narrow panel
Video metadata loaded with readyState 4 and no error
presentation.limit: Manual presentation checks on the local in-app browser; not exhaustive cross-browser certification

research.peer_review: Research claims and model-to-electronics abstraction boundaries independently audited within the AI-assisted workflow
